overthrow the government: In 1911, revolutionaries in China managed to overthrow the government and end more than two thousand years of imperial rule.
1911年，中國的革命人士成功推翻政府，結束了兩千多年的帝制統治。
overthrow a regime: After years of cruel rule, angry citizens joined together to overthrow a regime that had taken away their freedom.
經過多年殘酷的統治，憤怒的人民團結起來，推翻了一個剝奪他們自由的政權。
overthrow a theory: One surprising experiment can sometimes overthrow a theory that scientists have believed for hundreds of years.
一個令人驚訝的實驗有時就能推翻科學家相信了數百年的理論。
overturn a decision: After hundreds of parents complained, the principal agreed to overturn a decision to cancel the school trip.
在數百位家長抱怨之後，校長同意推翻取消校外教學的決定。
overturn a verdict: New DNA evidence led the higher court to overturn a verdict, and the innocent man was finally set free.
新的DNA證據使上級法院推翻判決，這名無辜的男子終於獲釋。
overturn a car: The typhoon winds were so strong that they could overturn a car parked on the street near the beach.
颱風的風勢強到能把停在海灘附近街上的車子吹翻。
overturn a ban: Students hope the school will overturn a ban on cellphones so they can use them during lunch break.
學生們希望學校撤銷手機禁令，讓他們能在午休時間使用手機。
be overwhelmed with work: Before the final exams, teachers tend to be overwhelmed with work and often stay at school until late at night.
期末考前，老師們往往被工作淹沒，常常留在學校直到深夜。
be overwhelmed by emotion: When she saw her son walk across the stage at graduation, she began to be overwhelmed by emotion and cried.
當她看到兒子在畢業典禮上走過舞台時，她激動難抑，哭了起來。
overwhelm the enemy: The general planned to overwhelm the enemy with ten times more soldiers, leaving them no chance to fight back.
將軍計劃用十倍的兵力壓倒敵人，讓他們毫無反擊的機會。
be overwhelmed by the response: The small bakery did not expect to be overwhelmed by the response, so it had to stop taking orders within an hour.
這家小麵包店沒料到反應熱烈得招架不住，一小時內就不得不停止接單。
owe an apology: I think you owe an apology to your sister because you broke her phone and then lied about it.
我覺得你欠你妹妹一個道歉，因為你弄壞了她的手機還說謊。
owe one's success to: The famous pianist says she owes her success to her mother, who drove her to lessons every weekend.
這位知名鋼琴家說她把成功歸功於母親，母親每個週末都載她去上課。
owe a debt of gratitude: We owe a debt of gratitude to the firefighters who risked their lives to save our neighbors last night.
我們深深感激昨晚冒著生命危險救出鄰居的消防員。
owe money: If you owe money to a friend, you should pay it back quickly, or you might lose the friendship.
如果你欠朋友錢，就應該趕快還，否則你可能會失去這段友誼。
owe it to oneself: You have worked hard all year, so you owe it to yourself to take a relaxing vacation this summer.
你辛苦工作了一整年，所以為自己著想，這個夏天應該好好放鬆度個假。
own up to a mistake: A good leader is brave enough to own up to a mistake instead of blaming the team members.
好的領導者有勇氣承認錯誤，而不是怪罪團隊成員。
own the stage: The moment the young singer started her first song, she seemed to own the stage, and nobody could look away.
這位年輕歌手一開始唱第一首歌，彷彿就稱霸了舞台，沒有人能移開目光。
own a house: My parents saved money for twenty years so that they could own a house instead of paying rent every month.
我父母存了二十年的錢，為的是擁有房子，而不必每個月付房租。
own one's decisions: As adults, we must own our decisions and stop blaming other people when things go wrong.
身為成年人，我們必須為自己的決定負責，事情出錯時不要再怪罪別人。
pace the room: While waiting for the test results, my father began to pace the room nervously, unable to sit still.
在等待檢查結果時，我父親緊張地在房間裡踱步，坐立難安。
pace oneself: The marathon is very long, so try to pace yourself at the start and save some energy for the final part.
馬拉松非常長，所以起跑時要試著調節步調，為最後一段保留一些體力。
set the pace: The fastest runner set the pace for the whole group, and the others tried hard to keep up with him.
跑最快的選手為整個團體定下步調，其他人努力跟上他。
at a snail's pace: Because of the heavy rain, the traffic on the highway moved at a snail's pace, and we arrived two hours late.
因為大雨，高速公路上的車流慢如蝸牛，我們晚了兩個小時才到。
pack a punch: This tiny red chili may look harmless, but it really packs a punch, so use only a little in your soup.
這顆小紅辣椒看起來無害，但其實很有力道（很辣），所以湯裡只要放一點點。
pack the hall: Hundreds of excited fans came early to pack the hall for the famous writer's speech on Saturday night.
數百位興奮的粉絲提早到場，擠滿禮堂聽這位知名作家週六晚上的演講。
pack one's bags: After his boss shouted at him again, Tom decided to pack his bags and leave the company for good.
在老闆又一次對他大吼之後，湯姆決定打包走人，永遠離開這家公司。
pack up: It is getting dark and starting to rain, so let's pack up and continue painting the wall tomorrow.
天色變暗又開始下雨了，我們收工吧，明天再繼續油漆牆壁。
be packed with information: This travel guide seems to be packed with information about local food, cheap hotels, and train times.
這本旅遊指南似乎資訊滿滿，有當地美食、便宜旅館和火車時刻的資料。
pack a lunch: To save money, I usually pack a lunch of rice and vegetables instead of eating at a restaurant.
為了省錢，我通常帶米飯和蔬菜的便當，而不是去餐廳吃。
